programme.title: An Unexpected Love
programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: Drive Time Murders
programme.desc: Drama with Cameron Daddo. A handsome attorney and his gossip columnist wife who host their own radio show, and also solve murder mysteries dig into a murder of a homeless lady.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: With Cresswell dead Hope and Ned are free to marry. They are, however, suspicious of John Hawkins' part in distributing the infected blankets and argue with him. As a result he has a heart attack and dies, asking Ned to take over his business though Ned is more concerned with helping Beth to hide Hope. Abe is visited in Oxford jail but Angelica's maid Agnes, who gives him a potion which simulates death and his 'corpse' is thrown into the plague pit, from where Agnes and her grandfather Adam rescue him. However Colonel Sidney is executed but Ned manages to obtain the colonel's writings, advocating freedom from Britain for the colonies, which he has smuggled into Boston. He and Hope are organizing a meeting for like-minded young colonists but they are interrupted by armed troopers who shoot and kill them. Beth returns to England to see the insurgents who took part in Monmouth's unsuccessful rebellion, being put to death. These include Agnes and Adam but she is reunited with Abe who has managed to escape.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 4: Vision Of A Murder
programme.desc: Sam lands a job photographing a new spa in Southern California for their brochure and brings her best friend Cassie along to enjoy some pampering. When one of the guests staying at the upscale retreat turns up dead, Sam is once again on the trail of a murderer. As the investigation progresses, Sam uncovers a scam that the spa Dr was testing unapproved drugs on the patrons.. filler implants, etc. without the patients' informed consent.

programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

programme.title: Redeemer
programme.desc: A writer is touched by the story of a former Black Panther who seams to have been wrongfully convicted to life imprisonment 20 years ago. The writer decides to try to help the now middle-aged convict get exonerated.

programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: Audrey's Rain
programme.desc: Heart-warming drama about a bitter, sharp-tongued spinster, whose future looks bleakwhen she is saddled with raising her nephew and niece after her sister commits suicide. Audrey resents that her family has robbed her of a life of her own, but when her childhood sweetheart reappears on the scene, her life takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: In 1864, an American Civil War troop struggles to survive when young Union (American Civil War) soldier Jim Rabb (Ryan Merriman) discovers that his mare has given birth to a Colt (horse). A superior officer orders Jim to shoot the foal because it may become a burden, but Jim - seeing the colt as a sign of hope and a reminder of the beauty of life - refuses. The colt remains with the men as they battle. When Confederacy (American Civil War)s overtake the camp and steal the colt, Jim must risk his life retrieving it.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's: Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

With our characters demoralized and dejected, the task of reigniting belief in a better world rests with the person Morgan and Madison set out to rescue in the first place -- Morgan's daughter, Mo.

programme.desc: A group of struggling individuals cross paths at a low-rent motel in Niagara Falls: a knockout waitress being recruited to star in low budget porn videos, a young couple with a criminal past struggling to recover their child from social services, a middle class husband and wife in a marriage that is disintegrating, a woeful drunken motel manager, a prostitute working to support two small children...

programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 7: At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: The Five People You Meet In Heaven
programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Deadly Isolation
programme.desc: Crafty Patrick Carlson and his violent accomplice Kyle Mumford have hidden in the woods up north for months after pulling off a major diamonds robbery in San Fracisco. They hoped to collect the loot from a third accomplice, who says it must be with Susan, the widow of professor Ron Mandaway, who probably hid it before committing suicide. Patrick adopts the false identity of Jeff Watkins, a retired entrepreneur, who supposedly had a yachting accident, so she'll take him into her luxury island villa. Jeff's charms win her confidence, but can't find the diamonds, and she seems unaware. Kyle loses his patience, and local sheriff Kirby Grantham, who regularly pays Susan a friendly visit, becomes a problem when his deputy finds Jeff's identity most suspicious.

The main character is the incompetent and cynical wizard Rincewind, who involuntarily finds himself as a guide to the naive tourist, Twoflower. After they are forced to flee from the city of Ankh-Morpork after a terrible fire they are sent on a journey across the disc which is unknowingly being controlled by a board game being played by the Gods. They meet two barbarians on their way out of morpork, Bravd and Weasel. After their visit to Wyrmberg, the upside-down mountain which is home to dragons that only exist in the imagination, their journey leads them to the country of Krull, perched on the very edge of the Discworld where they are thrown off the edge of the Disc due to the Krullian's urge to find out the gender of Great A'Tuin (the turtle which is swimming through space with four elephants resting the Disc on top).

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World

For years, scientists have been expounding theories - and warnings - of global-warming effects. It's disaster Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: The warming effect is creating new regions of extreme weather, but something else is triggering it; something that when combined with record-breaking heat waves creates explosions in the sky. With time running out, discredited scientist Faith Clavell, teams up with storm chaser Tornado Tommy (Emmy nominee Randy Quaid, "Elvis") and Judith to discover the trigger.

programme.title: Claire
programme.desc: Loosely based on a Japanese fairytale, an elderly male couple on a farm in the 1920's South find a little girl from the moon inside an ear of corn and raise her as their own.

programme.title: An Unexpected Love
programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: Mark Twain's Roughing It
programme.desc: Two-part drama with Robin Dunne. Ageing writer Mark Twain recalls the time he spent as a teenager seeking his fortune in the American West during the Gold Rush years.

programme.desc: Two-part drama with Robin Dunne. Ageing writer Mark Twain recalls the time he spent as a teenager seeking his fortune in the American West during the Gold Rush years.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Blackbeard
programme.desc: Action-packed historical drama starring Angus Macfadyen as the fearsome English pirate of the early 18th century known as Blackbeard. Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent from Great Britain to the seas surrounding the West Indies. His mission is to destroy an infamous pirate ship, known as The Queen Anne's Revenge, and to put an end to its villainous crew including the ill-famed Blackbeard. Also starring Mark Umbers and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
programme.desc: Negan's actions unravel alliances as the community is forced to choose a side. As the countdown towards Negan's fate begins, Maggie races against time to save him — and the community she worked hard to build.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: A Holocaust survivor heads for America where she dreams of starting a new life, but finds it difficult to put the past behind her, especially when she's forced to relive the nightmare of Auschwitz.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's: Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Maccabi" - "Olimpia Milano"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Dubai" - "Crvena Zvezda"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. programme.desc: Life in the African bush is a game of survival, for both hunter and hunted. Add babies to the mix and you'll see astounding feats of courage as mothers risk life and limb to protect their young. In spring, tall grass helps babies hide out of sight, but it also camouflages predators on the prowl. This game drive captures extraordinary behaviour as families and individuals battle to eat, defend, and raise young.

programme.title: Crocodiles of the Okavango
programme.desc: In Botswana's Okavango Delta, a young Nile crocodile embarks on her first season of motherhood. After winning the chance to breed, she faces fierce competition for nesting territory and the challenge of safeguarding her eggs through months of flooding, searing heat and relentless predators. Monitor lizards, mongooses, baboons and rival crocodiles all threaten her nest while she stands guard. When her hatchlings finally emerge, she carries them to safety in her jaws, but their journey has only begun. In a watery world where even crocodiles prey on their own kind, only a few of her offspring will survive. For this first-time mother, every choice is critical in a nursery where survival is anything but guaranteed.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: The lines between hunter and hunted become blurred in this epic safari. Hold on to your seats as an elephant charges through the bush with a lion dangling from its tusks. Watch as male leopards engage in a turf war, and a pack of hyenas bully a lion off of his buffalo kill. The safari intensifies as a leopard, wild dogs and hyenas fight for the same kill in an astonishing display of raw nature.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Battle Of the Swamp Dragons
programme.desc: South Florida is the only place on Earth that is home to both the American alligator and the American crocodile (and most recently, the Nile crocodile). But who is the baddest Florida predator? In this croc vs. gator fest, we'll compare the physical characteristics and behavior of these two prehistoric titans in the beautiful backdrop of South Florida to find out who is the true Lord of the Swamp… and identify one species that may threaten his throne.

programme.title: Cave Crocs of Gabon
programme.desc: A caving expedition recently discovered a community of dwarf crocodiles living in the Abanda Caves, Gabon. The crocs are living in pitch darkness, hunt bats and some have bright-orange skin. Part of the original team returns to find out more about this bizarre phenomenon. It's mission impossible to access the crocs world and there's no way of knowing what they might find.

programme.title: Jaguars vs. Crocs
programme.desc: Veteran wildlife photographer Steve Winter and cameraman Bertie Gregory capture the remarkable lives of Jaguars in the Pantanal of Brazil. A mother jaguar teaches her cub survival while a determined male jaguar named Scarface dives headfirst into the river to tackle the deadliest of opponents - 6-foot long caiman. Clever capybaras and playful giant otters stick with their family members to avoid being jaguar dinner.

programme.title: Florida Untamed: Where Reptiles Rule Compilation
programme.desc: Beyond the idyllic beaches and theme parks, there is a battleground where wildlife fights for survival. In ancient cypress swamps and lush mangrove-lined coasts, life-and-death drama unfolds among fearsome reptiles. In the swamps, American alligators reign supreme, while young hatchlings face deadly predators. Along the coastline, crocodiles and eastern diamondback rattlesnake's rule.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The crocodile is the world's largest reptilian predator, but it takes years of intensive training to learn to be lethal. It enters the world as a replica of its adult form, only four thousand times smaller. Built for the Kill: Crocodile follows the transformation of a tiny hatchling into an accomplished killer, exposing real life-and-death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Nicobar Islands: A Monkey's Long Tale
programme.desc: The Nicobar Islands were significantly impacted by the massive tsunami of 2004. This documentary is a compelling exploration of nature's ability to adapt to millions of years of gradual tectonic change and a sudden natural disaster, and a journey into a world few people are fortunate enough to see.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Assassins is a tantalizing exhibition of the continents top ten deadliest killers, from the microscopic to the massive all forged in the most challenging of environments. Discover the terminators that have fought their way to the top of the food chain by evolving the meanest, biggest and most lethal of weaponry. From the terrifying jaws of the great white to the hammer like foot of the secretary bird and the toxic sting of the Wahlberg's burrowing scorpion prepare yourself to delve into the secret world of Africa's Deadliest Assassins.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Invaders is a thrilling reveal of the continent's most lethal and fear-inspiring infiltrators. These specialized agents, armed to the teeth, have cunning strategies they deploy to dominate their every environment from the forests of Gabon to the Ethiopian highlands and even the frigid Atlantic Ocean. Peer through the eyes of an insider and unearth the terrifying secrets and surprising intelligence that each of these invaders keenly combine to become the meanest, biggest and most effective killers. From the strategic acumen of chimpanzees to the ruthless brutality of spotted hyenas and the streamlined teamwork of hunting orcas prepare yourself to be immersed into the tantalizing world of Africa's Deadliest Invaders.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Ambush Hunters is an awe-inspiring ride through a world of camouflage, patience, and precision. We follow these stealthy predators as they make use of their environments and special skill sets to avoid detection until the very last second. Lying in wait across the continent, from the lush Serengeti to the desert of Namibia, ambush predators are poised for action. Follow the lethal stonefish as he waits for his prey, and the most venomous cobra in Africa as he sneaks into a weavers nest. Prepare to be inspired by the leopard's quick-footedness and determination, and the crocodiles patient approach. A thrilling ride packed with sudden strikes from Africa's Deadliest Ambush Hunters.

Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. programme.title: Tucci Italijoje
programme.desc: Amerikiečių aktorius Stanley Tucci - vienas įvairiapusiškiausių žmonių Holivude. Iš Italijos kilęs vyras kino filmuose nesunkiai gali persikūnyti į žudiką, aukštosios mados dizainerį, linksmą sutuoktinį, landų žurnalistą, piktą žmogų ar keistuolį. Už filmavimo aikštelės ribų - jis gyvenimu besidžiaugiantis žmogus, su puikiu humoro jausmu ir didžiule meile gardžiam maistui. Tad ne nuostabu, kad jis kviečia žiūrovus atrasti tikrąją Italiją. Italijos regionų išskirtinumą, kuris geriausiai atsiskleidžia ruošiamuose patiekaluose. Stanley mėgaujasi maisto meniškumu vaizdingoje Toskanoje, aplanko Florenciją ir Sieną. Pasineria į kulinarinio kūrybiškumo dvasią Renesanso gimtinėje. Italijos pramoninėje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja novatorišką virtuvę ir futuristinį ūkininkavimą. Italijos vokiškai kalbančioje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja dvigubą kultūrinį tapatumą per šieno sriubą, slidinėjimą Dirndlio dieną, polentą kalnų šlaituose ir žvejybą ledyninėse upėse, ir tyrinėja, kaip istorinė pasienio įtampa formavo vietos virtuvę ir kultūrą. Šiame nelygiame regione Stanley tyrinėja, kaip reljefas formuoja maisto kultūrą. Jis kepa avieną ant grotelių avių ūkyje, mėgaujasi prancūziško stiliaus sekmadienio pietumis ir atskleidžia saldžią konfeti istoriją, atskleisdamas netikėtų kulinarinių malonumų.

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: Unsatisfied with the troubadour lifestyle, Max dreams of becoming a knight. After a run-in with a thief Max and Uncle Budrick travel to Byjovia, Budrick's hometown, but when they arrive, it is not as Uncle Budrick remembers it. In Byjovia, they meet Kevyn and learn that King Conrad disappeared and King Gastley, King Conrad's younger brother, took the throne and instituted strict and ridiculous rules. Their conversation is interrupted when Max sees two orphans being chased by King Gastley's Royal Guards. Seeing two people in trouble, Max stands up to King Gastley and his guards, saving the two orphans-Millie and Simon. However, Max's decision puts her in danger when King Gastley sentences her to death. Therefore, Uncle Budrick sacrifices himself to save Max and is taken by King Gastley to be the Royal Jester. Max is forced to run away with Kevyn, Simon, and Millie so that she can live to fight and save Uncle Budrick another day.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: In New Jersey, the Good Grief community focuses on a holistic way of dealing with grief, where children can give in to rage in 'the volcano room,' and say goodbye to a dying teddy bear patient in 'the hospital room.' Over the course of a year, we follow the weekly meetings and get close to Kimmy, Nicky, Peter, Nora, Nolan, and Mikayla and their close companion: grief. It is sometimes heartbreaking, but also humorous, to experience the questions about life and death through their open and curious minds. Grief is high and heavy as a mountain, but it helps you understand what has happened, and that death is irreversible.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
programme.desc: When his friends become obsessed with Rock's friend, Potato, Paper tries to win back their attention. When Rock, Scissors, and Pencil learn that Paper dislikes fart jokes, they search for one that'll make him laugh.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: Living together for the first time, half-siblings Jack and Lily are pushed outside their comfort zones as they learn to coexist while navigating new family dynamics, friends, and endless hijinks all while helping run the family's pet grooming and boarding business. With guidance from their parents and grandmother, the two will learn about each other's previously separate lives, blended identity, vibrant culture, and the importance of family.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities. When Katara inadvertently stumbles across a waterbending scroll that can help improve her ability while Aang is looking at a pirate's store, she decides to steal it after she realizes that she couldn't hope to afford it; but will she be capable of stealing from the pirates without causing herself and her friends trouble?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Book Club - Tutto puo' succedere
programme.desc: Diane Keaton e Jane Fonda in una commedia sulla riscoperta del desiderio. La lettura del romanzo "Cinquanta sfumature di grigio" risveglia le piccanti curiosita' di quattro signore.

programme.title: Big Wedding
programme.desc: Commedia con Robert De Niro, Katherine Heigl, Susan Sarandon e Diane Keaton. In occasione delle nozze del figlio adottivo, due coniugi, separati da anni, fingono di andare d'accordo.

programme.title: Perchè te lo dice mamma
programme.desc: Commedia sentimentale con Diane Keaton e Mandy Moore. Una madre iperprotettiva pubblica un annuncio su Internet per trovare un buon marito alla piu' introversa delle sue figlie.

programme.title: Il padrino
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Francis F. Coppola, con Marlon Brando e Al Pacino. Dopo l'attentato al padre, Mike comincia l'ascesa nella malavita a capo della famiglia Corleone.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Due uomini ossessionati dalle teorie complottistiche rapiscono l'amministratrice delegata di una grande azienda, convinti che sia un'aliena che vuole distruggere la Terra.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci portano alla scoperta dell'epica trilogia di Peter Jackson, disponibile su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Malcolm X
programme.desc: Denzel Washington, vincitore a Berlino, interpreta l’attivista per i diritti degli afroamericani nel biopic di Spike Lee che ne racconta la storia dall’infanzia fino all’assassinio.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: Il talento di Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Il matrimonio del mio migliore amico
programme.desc: Scatenata commedia romantica con Julia Roberts e Cameron Diaz rivali in amore. Una ragazza scopre di essere innamorata del suo miglior amico che sta per sposarsi e decide di sedurlo.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: George Clooney e Jennifer Lopez in un thriller di Steven Soderbergh, tratto da un romanzo di Elmore Leonard. Un rapinatore gentiluomo evade dal carcere e prende in ostaggio una poliziotta.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Oscar a Cuba Gooding Jr. per una commedia sul mondo del football con Tom Cruise e Renée Zellweger. Un procuratore sportivo perde il posto dopo aver rivelato delle scottanti verità.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Schindler's List - La lista di Schindler
programme.desc: 7 Oscar al kolossal di Steven Spielberg con Liam Neeson e Ben Kingsley. La vera storia del tedesco Oskar Schindler che salvò centinaia di ebrei dalla Shoah, impiegandoli nella sua fabbrica.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: La mummia
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar 2023 Brendan Fraser nel primo capitolo di una saga avventurosa. Un gruppo di esploratori risveglia la salma di un sacerdote egizio colpito da un'antica maledizione.

programme.title: Face/Off - Due facce di un assassino
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage e John Travolta in un thriller di John Woo. Grazie a una innovativa tecnica chirurgica, un agente dell'FBI e un pericoloso criminale si scambiano le identita'.

programme.title: The Bodyguard - Guardia del corpo
programme.desc: Esordio al cinema per Whitney Houston, con Kevin Costner in un cult romantico degli anni 90. Un ex federale viene incaricato di proteggere una popstar minacciata da un maniaco.

programme.title: Se scappi, ti sposo
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: Salvate il soldato Ryan
programme.desc: 5 Oscar per il film di guerra firmato Steven Spielberg, con Tom Hanks e Matt Damon. Dopo lo sbarco in Normandia, un plotone va in cerca dell'unico soldato superstite di quattro fratelli.

programme.title: Striptease
programme.desc: Rimasta senza denaro per la causa sull'affidamento della figlia, una madre determinata a non perderla accetta un lavoro in un locale di striptease.

programme.title: Boogie Nights - L'altra Hollywood
programme.desc: Paul Thomas Anderson firma l'epopea di un promettente pornoattore, interpretato da Mark Wahlberg, sullo sfondo dei trasgressivi anni 70. Nel cast Heather Graham e Julianne Moore.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: L'iniziazione
programme.desc: Chris Pine nella quinta pellicola della saga nata dalla penna di Tom Clancy. Ryan vola a Mosca per sventare un folle piano terroristico che farebbe crollare l'economia statunitense.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si sfidano a colpi di pellicole con protagonista Jack Ryan, disponibili su Sky Cinema Collection fino al 26 luglio.

programme.title: Caccia a Ottobre Rosso
programme.desc: Sean Connery e Alec Baldwin nel primo film dedicato all'agente della CIA, Jack Ryan. 1984: un sottomarino atomico diventa l'altissima posta in gioco nella Guerra Fredda tra Usa e Urss.

programme.title: Giochi di potere
programme.desc: Harrison Ford nel thriller dal romanzo di Tom Clancy. In vacanza a Londra, l'agente della CIA Jack Ryan sventa un attentato dell'IRA ma viene braccato dal fratello di un terrorista.

programme.title: Sotto il segno del pericolo
programme.desc: Ritorna Harrison Ford nei panni di Jack Ryan nel terzo film dai romanzi di spionaggio di Tom Clancy. L'agente sfida una banda di narcotrafficanti colombiani protetti dal governo americano.

programme.title: Al vertice della tensione
programme.desc: Thriller con Ben Affleck e Morgan Freeman nel quarto film basato su Jack Ryan, il personaggio creato da Tom Clancy. Il giovane analista della CIA deve fermare un gruppo di terroristi.

programme.title: Genitori vs Influencer
programme.desc: Fabio Volo, Ginevra Francesconi e Giulia De Lellis nella commedia Sky Original di Michela Andreozzi. Un prof si scontra con la figlia teenager per colpa dei social... ma diventa influencer.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo d'animazione con le bambole targate Dreamworks. Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.title: Biancaneve
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e' la Regina Cattiva in un'irriverente versione della famosa fiaba. Dopo la morte del padre, Biancaneve deve affrontare la perfida matrigna. Sara' aiutata da 7 nanetti briganti.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Cattivissimo me 3
programme.desc: Terzo successo al box office per i personaggi targati Illumination. Mentre i Minions si dimettono, Gru scopre di avere un fratello gemello, Dru. Insieme daranno la caccia a Balthazar Bratt.

programme.title: Animali fantastici: i crimini di Grindelwald
programme.desc: Eddie Redmayne, Johnny Depp e Jude Law nel secondo spin-off della saga di "Harry Potter", scritto da J.K. Rowling. Albus Silente deve fermare il diabolico piano dell'evaso Grindelwald.

programme.title: I Croods 2 - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Seconda avventura animata per gli sprizzanti cavernicoli. Dopo aver accolto il giovane Guy, i Croods vanno in cerca di un luogo chiamato ‘casa’. Una volta trovato, dovranno fare i conti con i suoi abitanti, l'evoluto clan dei Superior, finché una nuova minaccia non porterà le due famiglie a unire le loro forze.

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale
programme.desc: Una coppia porta la giovane figlia, Claire, nell'albergo del nonno in Italia per dirle che si stanno separando. Nella speranza di riavvicinarli, Claire chiede a tutta la famiglia di trascorrere un ultimo Natale insieme, anche se è agosto.

programme.title: La Befana vien di notte II - Le origini
programme.desc: Prequel con Monica Bellucci, Fabio De Luigi e Zoe Massenti tra avventure e incantesimi. Una giovane orfana entra in conflitto con un avido barone, ma una strega gentile la salvera'.

programme.title: Genitori vs Influencer
programme.desc: Fabio Volo, Ginevra Francesconi e Giulia De Lellis nella commedia Sky Original di Michela Andreozzi. Un prof si scontra con la figlia teenager per colpa dei social... ma diventa influencer.

programme.desc: Un racconto corale dietro le quinte della serie. Attori, registi e capi reparto svelano il set, le scelte creative e il successo del progetto.

programme.title: Il gigante di ferro
programme.desc: Toccante animazione dal regista premio Oscar per "Gli incredibili". Anni 50: il piccolo Hogarth incontra un robot piovuto dallo spazio. Dovrà proteggerlo da inchieste e pregiudizi.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si sfidano a colpi di risate per raccontarci i film campioni d'incassi con Checco Zalone protagonista, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand. (ITA 2025).

programme.desc: SpongeBob, in compagnia degli inseparabili amici Patrick, Squiddi, Sandy e Mr. Krabs, intraprende un viaggio nelle profondità dell'oceano per affrontare il fantasma dell'Olandese volante.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro - Parte III
programme.desc: Si chiude nel Far West la trilogia cult con Michael J. Fox per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Marty viaggia indietro nel tempo fino al 1885 per salvare la vita dell'amico Doc Brown.

programme.title: La casa delle bambole di Gabby

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Fiaba di arti marziali con un simpatico e goloso panda. Secondo un'antica profezia, Po sarebbe il prescelto 'Guerriero del Dragone'. Si affida così a un severo maestro di Kung Fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Il panda più famoso del cinema torna a combattere a colpi di kung fu. Per conquistare uno sconosciuto e incredibile potere, il Guerriero Dragone Po dovrà scavare nel proprio passato.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della spassosa saga animata con l'inarrestabile panda Po. Per affrontare il perfido Kai, Po insegna i segreti del kung fu ai miti abitanti del suo villaggio natale.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.title: Spongebob: Un'avventura Da Pirati

programme.title: Cicogne in missione
programme.desc: Pellicola d'animazione dai creatori di "The Lego Movie". Le cicogne consegnano ormai i bebe' online, ma un imprevisto obbliga il loro miglior corriere a una corsa contro il tempo.

programme.title: Alla fine ci sei tu
programme.desc: Asa Butterfield e Maisie Williams in una storia di crescita. Un ragazzo ipocondriaco affronta le sue peggiori paure quando accetta di esaudire gli ultimi desideri di una coetanea malata.

programme.title: Il mistero della casa del tempo
programme.desc: Jack Black, Cate Blanchett e Kyle MacLachlan in un intrigante fantasy di Eli Roth. L'orfanello Lewis si trasferisce a casa dell'eccentrico zio, scoprendo un mondo di incantesimi e streghe.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia del giovane Simone Bozzelli. Yuri ha vent'anni quando incontra Agostino, un animatore girovago con cui inizia un viaggio alla ricerca del senso della liberta'.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano su alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista premio Oscar che ha fatto e continua a far sognare generazioni di spettatori.

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.title: Le buone stelle - Broker
programme.desc: Kore-eda dirige Song Kang-ho (Parasite), premiato a Cannes. Due benevoli contrabbandieri di bambini intercettano un bebe' abbandonato in una 'baby box', ma la polizia e' sulle loro tracce.

programme.title: Eravamo bambini
programme.desc: Lorenzo Richelmy, Alessio Lapice e Massimo Popolizio in un film tra vendetta e innocenza perduta. Vent'anni dopo aver assistito a un crimine le storie di 4 coetanei si intrecciano di nuovo.

programme.title: Ammazzare stanca
programme.desc: La storia vera di Antonio Zagari, figlio di un boss della 'ndrangheta calabrese trapiantata in Lombardia. Nei primi anni '70 Antonio sviluppa un'avversione fisica per la violenza e decide di ribellarsi alla tradizione criminale di famiglia.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: In viaggio con Adele
programme.desc: Alessandro Haber, Sara Serraiocco e Isabella Ferrari in un toccante road movie. Un anziano attore scopre di avere una figlia e parte con lei per un viaggio che cambiera' le loro vite.

programme.title: Baaria
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige un grande cast italiano in un emozionante kolossal che racconta la Sicilia, dal ventennio fascista fino agli anni 80, attraverso la storia di una famiglia.

programme.title: Gli immortali
programme.desc: Una giovane donna, tecnico delle luci per una compagnia teatrale che sta allestendo "Le baccanti" di Euripide, deve gestire il ritorno nella sua vita del padre malato e fare i conti con i dubbi esistenziali che la assillano.

programme.desc: Kim Rossi Stuart dirige e interpreta un film esistenzialista dalle ambientazioni western. Il giovane Tommaso torna nel ranch di famiglia per aiutare il padre ad addestrare un cavallo.

programme.desc: Susanna Nicchiarelli dirige un biopic su Santa Chiara con Margherita Mazzucco e Andrea Carpenzano. Una ragazza lascia la ricca famiglia per seguire l'insegnamento di Francesco d'Assisi.

programme.title: Tornare
programme.desc: Cristina Comencini dirige Giovanna Mezzogiorno in un dramma psicologico. Alice torna in Italia per il funerale di suo padre e viene travolta dai ricordi della propria giovinezza.

programme.title: La notte più lunga dell'anno
programme.desc: Dramma corale con Ambra Angiolini. Potenza: attorno a un'area di servizio, la notte del solstizio d'inverno diventa il punto di svolta per un politico, una cubista e un gruppo di ragazzi.

programme.title: La migliore offerta

programme.desc: Giovanni Virgilio narra un pezzo di storia siciliana, con Alessio Vassallo, Stella Egitto e Nino Frassica. Dopo un'infanzia segnata dalla guerra, un uomo diventa l'onesto sindaco del paese.

programme.desc: Dall'omonimo romanzo, Chloé Zhao dirige Jessie Buckley, premiata con l'Oscar, e Paul Mescal nel film che racconta uno degli episodi più tragici nella vita dei coniugi Shakespeare.

programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Il Capitale Umano - Human Capital
programme.desc: Marisa Tomei, Liev Schreiber e Peter Sarsgaard nell’adattamento del romanzo di Stephen Amidon. La relazione fra i rispettivi figli adolescenti spinge la vita di due famiglie in una spirale di rapporti ambigui e torbidi affari. Una svolta inaspettata stravolgerà gli equilibri.

programme.title: A.I. - Intelligenza Artificiale
programme.desc: Da un'idea di Stanley Kubrick, un'opera di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un androide bambino, in grado di provare emozioni, intraprende un lungo viaggio per scoprire le proprie origini.

programme.title: Orlando
programme.desc: Daniele Vicari dirige una favola moderna con un intenso Michele Placido. In Belgio per rivedere il figlio ricoverato in ospedale, un anziano contadino scopre di avere una nipote.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale

programme.desc: Esordio cinematografico del duo Colapesce Dimartino in un road movie con Stefania Rocca e Corrado Fortuna. Tre anni dopo lo scioglimento, due musicisti si ritrovano in un bizzarro progetto.

programme.title: Il talento di Mr. C
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage nella parodia di se stesso in una action-comedy con Pedro Pascal. Caduto in disgrazia, l'attore accetta la generosa offerta di un fan, ignorando che l'uomo e' un criminale.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: Cosi' e' la vita
programme.desc: Aldo, detto Bancomat, è un detenuto di mezza tacca. In qualche modo, riesce a sequestrare il poliziotto Giacomo e il malcapitato Giovanni, un inventore di giocattoli pignolo e petulante.

programme.title: Trafficanti
programme.desc: Graffiante commedia di Todd Phillips basata su una storia vera, con Jonah Hill e Miles Teller. Due ragazzi firmano un contratto con il Pentagono per armare l'esercito americano in Iraq.

programme.title: I migliori giorni
programme.desc: Massimiliano Bruno ed Edoardo Leo registi e interpreti di una commedia con un grande cast in 4 episodi, ognuno dedicato a una festività fra disagi, vendette e tradimenti.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchi
programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: Tolo Tolo
programme.desc: Checco Zalone dirige e interpreta la commedia campione d'incassi scritta con Paolo Virzi. Inseguito dai creditori, Checco fugge in Africa, ma una guerra ne scombina i programmi.

programme.title: I pompieri
programme.desc: Lino Banfi e Massimo Boldi fra incendi e allagamenti, in un mare di risate. Due vigili del fuoco in pensione ritornano in servizio unendosi ai colleghi più giovani della disastrosa squadra 17, il cui caposquadra è affetto da sonnambulismo. Oltre ai guai in cui finiscono ogni volta che affrontano una missione, questi goffi pompieri dovranno vedersela con lo zelante comandante della caserma e con un fastidioso giornalista alla ricerca continua di scoop. Cast arricchito da Christian De Sica, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato e da un cameo di Moana Pozzi.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchissimi
programme.desc: Fausto Brizzi dirige Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano nel sequel di "Poveri ma ricchi". I Tucci entrano in politica e indicono un referendum per sancire l'indipendenza del loro borgo.
